notes: Replace Copilot's full local-archive scan with a compact indexed lookup capped to bounded matching candidates, so archive size no longer determines the work done for every customer message.

Add Settings > Archive performance to build, pause, and safely resume a one-time index migration beside the existing Knowledge Hub. All raw threads, reviewed knowledge, annotations, and backups remain untouched; no reset is required.

Index new retrieved or imported threads incrementally, show exact thread and safe-answer progress, and avoid marking questions unanswered while the index is incomplete. Reviewed knowledge still ranks first and Copilot remains draft-only.
